reserves.name: USD0 locked in the bUSD0 bond contract

reserveReview.rationale: Usual documents bUSD0 as a fixed-notional bond token backed one-for-one by locked USD0. Par redemption before the June 11, 2028 maturity requires recombining bUSD0 with rt-bUSD0; bUSD0 alone redeems one-for-one at maturity, while earlier secondary-market exits may occur below par.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Usual bUSD0 product documentation last updated February 16, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The direct reserve dependency is fully identified as USD0; holder liquidity before maturity depends on the separate redemption-right token, governance-enabled floor redemption, or secondary markets.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Usual states that USD0 collateralizing bUSD0 is locked and cannot be allocated to its lending vaults, but the position remains exposed to the bUSD0 and underlying USD0 smart-contract and governance structures.
